+title: 'ElicitationView form mode: field views, tabbed layout, validation gate, slots (plan §13.1, §13.2)'
+---
+## What
+Create `Sources/AgentViewKit/Elicitation/ElicitationView.swift`, `ElicitationFieldViews.swift`, `ElicitationLayout.swift`, and `ElicitationOverrides.swift`, per plan.md §13.1 and §13.2.
+
+- `ElicitationFieldContext { schema, value: Binding<JSONValue?>, validation }`.
+- Field views: `ElicitationTextField` (defaults to an EditorKit single-line or multi-line field, chosen by `maxLength`), `ElicitationNumberField` (stepper, or slider with both bounds), `ElicitationToggleField`, `ElicitationDateField` (`DatePicker`), `ElicitationSingleChoiceField` (radio group up to five, menu above), `ElicitationMultiChoiceField` (checkboxes with min and max items).
+- Typed override modifiers: `.elicitationTextField`, `.elicitationNumberField`, `.elicitationToggleField`, `.elicitationDateField`, `.elicitationSingleChoiceField`, `.elicitationMultiChoiceField`, `.elicitationHeader`, `.elicitationLayout`, `.elicitationFooter`.
+- Layout: one field inline; more than one tabbed, with a chip per field that shows required and answered marks. The threshold is a parameter of the layout slot.
+- Header names the requesting server and shows the message. Footer has Submit (`.glassProminent`, disabled until `isComplete`), Decline, Cancel. Esc maps to `cancel`. VoiceOver focus moves to the view on appear.
+- Submit calls `respond(to:_:)` with `.accept(values)`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A one-field request renders inline; a three-field request renders three tabs.
+- [ ] Submit is disabled until every required field validates, then enabled.
+- [ ] Each override modifier replaces its default.
+- [ ] Esc sends `.cancel`.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Elicitation/ElicitationViewHostedTests.swift`: layouts, the gate, overrides, and the three actions through `NoopThreadActions`.
+- [ ] `swift test --filter AgentViewKitTests` exits 0.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
